snippet.title: Naughty Elves - 2D pixelart Christmas puzzle game [Trailer 2]
snippet.description:
This is the Release Trailer for our Christmas themed 2D pixelart puzzle game, called "Naughty Elves"

Buy it now on Steam with 10% off!

For more info, visit https://naughtyelves.gurkenlabs.de/
Steam Page: http://store.steampowered.com/app/750620/

Music by Aaron Mist.
